definitions.explanation: A personality trait of someone who tends to worry excessively about things, even when there is no particular reason to do so. Describes a person who habitually frets and cannot relax.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{苦労性|くろうしょう}だ。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{苦労性|くろうしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}している→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧。
examples.english: My mother is a worrywart and is always worrying about something.

examples.japanese: {苦労性|くろうしょう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなく→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Because of my worrying nature, I always can't sleep before a trip.

notes:
Describes a temperamental tendency rather than a specific worry. The suffix ⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧ here indicates an innate nature or disposition (similar to ⟦{怒|おこ}りっぽい→怒りっぽい：30581_okorippoi⟧⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧ but as a compound). Someone who is {苦労性|くろうしょう} worries even about things that may not warrant concern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苦労性|くろうしょう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person with a worrying disposition
- {苦労性|くろうしょう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a worrying personality

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{心配性|しんぱいしょう}→心配性：07774_shinpaishou⟧: worrywart — very similar, slightly more common
- ⟦{苦労知|くろうし}らず→苦労知らず：22570_kuroushirazu⟧: carefree, having no hardships — the opposite type
- {気苦労|きぐろう}: mental stress, worry — the stress itself
- ⟦{取|と}り{越|こ}し{苦労|ぐろう}→取り越し苦労：10622_torikoshigurou⟧: needless worry, borrowing trouble
